[SWS_CM_10517] Failures in sending a SOME/IP trigger
⌈
If the send-
ing of the SOME/IP trigger fails locally (due to a network error which is notified to
the ara::com implementation), the ara::com implementation shall return an er-
ror indicating "network binding failure" in the Result of the Send() method of the
respective Trigger class (see [SWS_CM_00721]).
⌋
